verdict.rationale: Kling documents a RESTful API with JWT authentication (AccessKey + SecretKey), global and China API endpoints, and per-unit pricing for Text/Image-to-Video generations. That shows a documented API for submitting video jobs, but nothing in the pack covers the job lifecycle or how a developer retrieves the finished asset. Missing for 10: documented task submission and status-polling endpoints, retrieval/download of the finished video asset (URL or callback), and independent or hands-on corroboration of an end-to-end API workflow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can submit a video generation job through a documented API and retrieve the finished asset

citations.quote: RESTful API with JWT-based authentication (AccessKey + SecretKey)
